proposals.source: BOOTSTRAP Step 9 dual-contract audit; v0.2 section 12 (Application level: graphics, input)

proposals.source: v0.2 section 13 (frame-time distributions); TECHNIQUES.md game-dev class (frame budget as a signal stratum)
proposals.rationale: MEASUREMENT_RECORDED carries p50/p99 summaries; a sampled ambient tag needs a cadence, and no measured cadence exists yet. BOOTSTRAP Step 5: an ambient tag with no cadence is not admitted.

proposals.source: v0.2 section 11.2 (auto-reset event example: signaled_after_consumption postcondition)
proposals.rationale: GUEST_CALL_RETURNED plus hb_refs records wait completion and the satisfying signal; an explicit object-state line would let a probe assert the postcondition without inferring it from call returns.

proposals.source: v0.2 section 5.1 (newly loaded modules; code changed during execution; publication contract)
proposals.rationale: The compile side has CODE_TARGET_DISCOVERED (loaded_module, generated_code) and TRANSLATION_INVALIDATED (code_modified); the guest side needs the observation that triggered them for code-publication probes.

proposals.source: v0.2 section 11.1 (reference profile fields); constraint E13 (ids resolve to registry files)
proposals.rationale: Profiles currently live as files under profiles/; a tag would put profile creation on the record. Not needed until profiles change during a run.
proposals.revisit: a run that registers or edits a profile

proposals.candidate: GUEST_CLOCK_READ(clock=qpc) values are non-decreasing per process
proposals.rationale: Clock behavior is contract content, not vocabulary: each clock's monotonicity, wraparound, and cross-thread rules belong in contracts/windows.clock.* with evidence. Putting it in the vocabulary would assert a behavior without evidence.

ratified.grounds: v0.2 3.1 and 11.1; PRINCIPLES.md commitment 1 (vocabulary names events, contracts define allowed behavior)

proposals.source: Sprint 002: substrate.api.canonical_bytes raises NonCanonicalValueError for |n| > 2^53-1 (RFC 8785); signals/0.1.json types.version text says major.minor.patch while version is '0.1'
proposals.rationale: Both are already enforced by the generated validators (scripts/gen_events.py); no tag or field changes. Written into the vocabulary at the next version bump so the constraint is visible outside the generator.

candidate: GUEST_THREAD_STATE_OBSERVED (thread_id, thread_seq, hb_refs, subject_thread_id, thread_state, wait_reason, source)
proposals.source: user decision 2026-10-08 ('dont defer! lets do it'); project review 2026-10-08 §4.7; contract windows.event.auto_reset.single_signal open question 4
proposals.rationale: The event contract's precondition (both waiters pending at SetEvent) rested on Sleep(200). No guest tag could record one thread observing another's scheduler state, so the precondition could not be witnessed in a trace.

ratified.grounds: project — v0.2 §3 (a schedule must be witnessed, not assumed), §11.1 (observed evidence); SDD — PRINCIPLES.md proposal taxonomy (new tag bumps the minor version); practice — Microsoft Learn NtQuerySystemInformation, .NET ThreadState and ThreadWaitReason (retrieved 2026-10-08)
